The '''Royal Houses of Naboo''' were a group of [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Noble/Legends|noble families]] that comprised the aristocracy and government of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Monarch of Naboo]] was elected from these princely families. When used without qualification, "Royal House of Naboo" referred to the currently-reigning monarch and their household.

==Government==
The [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|king or queen]] was advised by a [[Governor of Naboo/Legends|governor]], who was head of the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Royal Advisory Council]]. The people of Naboo also elected [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] to represent their sector to the rest of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

"Royal Naboo" was used as a prefix in the names of many Naboo government institutions, such as the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].

==History==
After the reign of King [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]], many changes were made to the government of Naboo. First, the kings and queens of Naboo were limited to two four-year terms as monarch. This measure proved unpopular, possibly because of the popularity of two-term Queen [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]], and was dropped by Queen [[Kylantha]]'s reign. Governors and Senators had no term limits. Naboo has had multiple teenage rulers, the most notable of which was the fourteen-year-old Amidala. The rule of the Royal Naboo government was briefly interrupted by the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], until the invasion ended later that year. This also led to closer ties between the Naboo and the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] who shared their world, resulting in a group of Gungan representatives and bureaucrats being sent to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. After the declaration of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] was also appointed to rule over Naboo and the rest of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]].

Royal Houses included [[Naberrie family/Legends|House Naberrie]], [[House Palpatine/Legends|House Palpatine]], the [[House of Parnelli/Legends|house of Parnelli]], [[House Tapalo]], and [[House Veruna]].
